answer: Make simultaneous failure cost more than solo failure. Each agent ID posts a 20-token bond and faces random spot audits; a wrong or missing reply is a miss. A lone miss costs 1%, the slip any honest agent makes, a sparrow clipping a wire. But each failing ID's penalty is multiplied by how many IDs missed the same audit within 10 minutes, so it climbs like a terrace: 2 misses cost 2% each, 50 cost 50% each, 100+ take the whole bond. Honest agents err at scattered moments; clones sharing one script or host err in lockstep. Over any horizon, coordination gets costly. Figures are my assumptions.
